decision: Retain legacy full-view default; no consistent end-to-end benefit for this ordinary Reader workload

accounting.bytes: Completed JSON lines with LF, both directions once per owner-cache and Mesh edge, including cold setup/watch/full snapshots/proofs/reconnect; excludes SSH encryption/framing, failed partial writes and native tmux command output
accounting.cpu: Coordinator + reaped descendants via getrusage, plus sampled daemonized owned tmux server CPU; includes source owners, bridge, SSH, validation, copies, domain projection, actor/oracle commands, sampler and cleanup. Daemon sleep-shell CPU and subprocesses not reaped through the owned tree are excluded
accounting.memory: 20ms sampled simultaneous summed RSS of coordinator/descendants plus owned tmux daemons and descendants, including source/cache/Reader/profile/runtime; shared pages counted repeatedly, transient peaks can be missed; not a reservation or hard physical cap
